subject.title: [AI] fix(memory): backfill provider.model with resolved model name in…

question: Should OpenClaw accept this source-layer `provider.model` normalization for memory indexes before the broader provider auto-detection work lands?
rationale: The patch is narrow and appears correct, but it changes the model identity used for persisted memory metadata and vector lookup when adapters return an empty model, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Land after upgrade-aware review
options.body: Accept the narrow backfill if maintainers are satisfied that the tests and terminal proof cover the existing-index identity path.

options.title: Request full persisted-index proof
options.body: Ask for a live existing-index reindex plus `memory_search` transcript before merge if maintainers want stronger end-to-end upgrade evidence.

options.title: Pause for broader provider policy
options.body: Hold this PR only if maintainers want the source backfill bundled with the auto-provider migration decision tracked elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Land after upgrade-aware review
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow backfill if maintainers are satisfied that the tests and terminal proof cover the existing-index identity path.
